workdir.description: Working directory to execute the command in. Defaults to the current working directory. When possible, avoid changing directories in the command and set the working directory here instead.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (default 120000). When it expires, a foreground command moves to the background and a background command is stopped.

background.description: Run the command in the background and return immediately (useful for dev servers and long-running builds). You do not need to use '&' at the end of the command when using this parameter. You will be notified when it completes. DO NOT poll for completion.

shellID.description: Present only while the command is still running in the background. You will be notified when it exits. A result without shellID is final.

exitCode.description: The exit code once the command has exited: 0 means success. null while it is still running, or when a signal ended it.

signal.description: The signal that ended the command, if any

killed.description: Why the command ended without an exit code, when the reason is known: the machine's worker restarted or lost the process, or the local process daemon stopped

outputPath.description: File with the full output, when output was truncated or the command is running in the background

pid.description: Process ID while the command is running in the background

output.description: Combined stdout and stderr as one string; there are no separate stdout or stderr fields. While shellID is present it is a notice instead, and the output streams to outputPath.
